content:
**Makeshift Warrior** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Melee weapons break slower.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Melee weapons break 80% slower. | 0032DA71 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Melee weapons break 60% slower. | 0032DA70 | 
| ★ | 1 | Melee weapons break 40% slower. | 0032DA6F | 

Before Update 60, the perk had 5 ranks that increased melee weapons durability by 20%/35%/50%/65%/80%. The perk also allowed crafting of certain melee weapons; with higher ranks, more melee weapons were available for crafting. As of this patch, melee weapons can be crafted without any perks.
